stories.title: Joe Milton has huge game as Eagles shock Cowboys on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Dallas blew a 21-point lead as Philly made a spectacular comeback with Milton at the helm.

stories.title: Tomlin saddened by Rodgers' bitter exit, calls situation 'a dumpster fire'
stories.summary: Mike Tomlin said he was saddened by Aaron Rodgers' tumultuous exit from Pittsburgh and disagreed with how the QB "aired out" his grievances against Mike McCarthy.

stories.title: Steelers owner: Rodgers' 'insubordination can't be tolerated,' backs McCarthy
stories.summary: Steelers owner Art Rooney II reacted to Wednesday's fiery interview from Aaron Rodgers by saying he was "disappointed in where this went" with their now-former quarterback, adding he has "100% confidence in Mike McCarthy."

stories.title: Cowboys' Jones backing Schottenheimer despite 'damning setbacks'
stories.summary: Jerry Jones said he did not anticipate making immediate changes but still labeled the Cowboys' latest fourth-quarter collapse as a "damning" setback.

stories.title: WR Rice, Chiefs miffed at dropped pass call late in loss to Bills
stories.summary: WR Rashee Rice -- along with several members of the Chiefs -- felt he caught the ball on a pivotal third-down pass with less than two minutes left at the Bills.
